propositions: JiraDataCenterTransport lacks twelve methods the core reconciler calls, causing crashes at three call sites and silent degradation (no syncing) at seven others.
The port TicketTransport declares only six members but the core requires twenty-one distinct transport methods, leaving gaps undetectable until runtime.

A writing reconcile pass against DC crashes on set_entity_property and would crash repeatedly on eleven other absent methods, each requiring triage to IMPLEMENT, NOT-IMPLEMENT with NotImplementedError, or document as unreachable.
Reporter mutations re-emit on every DC pass because inbound_fields._identity_of reads only accountId (null on DC) rather than name, breaking idempotence without raising an error.
Transport conformance must be asserted at backend construction time with @runtime_checkable on the port, so missing members fail loudly rather than hidden until a call site is reached.
